name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-11-03, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
